content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire protection, life safety and MEP contracting for buildings; no road, paving or materials business like the target."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures asphalt plants and quarry equipment for contractors; sells machinery rather than building roads or producing materials."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Self-performs site work, paving and crushed stone base with its own asphalt plant, serving developers and municipalities much like the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Makes municipal street sweepers, vacuum trucks and safety equipment; a vehicle manufacturer, not a road builder or materials producer."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Designs and manufactures asphalt plants and parts for producers; an equipment OEM that does not build roads or sell paving materials."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds highways and bridges for public agencies and produces aggregates, asphalt and concrete from its own quarries and plants, matching the target."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Electrical, lighting and communications contracting for buildings and utilities; no road, paving or aggregate business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rail track components, friction management and precast products for railroads; rail-focused rather than highway and paving work."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Oil refining with retail fuel stations and pipelines; sells asphalt as a by-product but is not a construction or paving business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing and leasing with highway guardrail products; railcars dominate and it does not build roads or produce paving materials."}]}
